Application Data.NAME: Kitchen Smart Co.
Application Data.MAILING ADDRESS: 1234 Culinary Way, Suite 100, Kitchen City, CA 90210-1234
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Kitchen Smart Co. specializes in the retail sale of kitchen and home accessories, including cookware, bakeware, small appliances, and home décor items. Our operations include showcasing a wide range of quality products in our store, while our dedicated staff provides personalized customer service to assist shoppers in finding the right items for their needs. We do not offer installation or repair services, ensuring that we minimize liability associated with subcontracting work. With a focus on maintaining a safe shopping environment, we implement stringent safety protocols and conduct regular training for our employees to reduce the risk of accidents. Our inventory is valued under $500,000, and we employ security measures to safeguard against theft and vandalism, supporting our commitment to operational excellence and customer satisfaction.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 03/15/2023, a minor water leak occurred in the store due to a malfunctioning display sink, causing damage to flooring and inventory valued at $2,500. The claim was filed on 03/20/2023 and is currently in the final review stage with a status of pending resolution.
